canonical_statement: For a number field K with r1 real embeddings and r2 conjugate pairs of complex embeddings, the unit group of its ring of integers is the direct product of its finite roots-of-unity subgroup and a free abelian group of rank r1 + r2 - 1.
domain_and_universes: K : Type u with Field K and NumberField K; ring of integers O K; conclusion in Prop
conclusion: The units modulo torsion form a finite free Z-module of unit rank, and every unit has a unique torsion-times-fundamental-units expression.

alternate_encodings.target: O_K^x is isomorphic to mu(K) times Z^(r1+r2-1)

alternate_encodings.relationship: rank component of the legacy Lean candidate

excluded_degenerate_cases: None intended. Rank zero, K = Q, and the empty product of fundamental units remain included and require mutation tests.
